children: Cathay General Bancorp received regulatory approval to increase its share buyback program by $50 million.
The increase was previously approved by the board and authorizes Cathay to repurchase up to $200 million in stock.
As of Nov. 25, after giving effect to the increase, Cathay had about $113 million in remaining availability under the buyback program.
The increased program will expire on April 23, 2027, the same expiration date as the original program.
